clue.text: Backing man and daughter to crack cryptic clues, going slowly

parts.note: backing a cause is getting behind it

indicators.note: to crack something is to break into it, so these letters go inside the others
cryptic means puzzling or obscure, so the letters of clues are scrambled

parts.note: HE is a man, as a pronoun

explanation.surface: A solver backed by a man and his daughter tackles cryptic clues but makes slow progress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cryptic' looks like a description of the clues, but it is the anagram signal, making SCULE; 'to crack' splits it to take HE + D.
explanation.definitionFit: Something running later than planned is making slow progress against its timetable.

clue.text: Something soothing spoken by man in the corner in a holiday home

parts.note: a balm soothes and heals
oral means spoken rather than written
in chess the castle, or rook, is the piece that starts in the corner of the board

explanation.surface: Someone speaks a few calming words while relaxing in a corner of a holiday cottage.
explanation.walkthrough: A chess 'man' is any piece; the one in the corner is the castle. BALMORAL CASTLE is the British royal family's Scottish summer residence.
explanation.definitionFit: The royals traditionally spend their summer break at this Scottish estate, so it is literally their vacation residence.

clue.text: Threw party, embracing new game

indicators.note: embracing means holding inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: someone who threw a party had a ball, with the article dropped

explanation.surface: Someone threw a party and introduced a new game for the guests.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embracing' puts N inside HAD BALL, between HA and D.
explanation.definitionFit: Handball is a team sport in which players pass and throw a ball into a goal.

clue.text: Signs midday's about time when lunch is taken?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes around the others

parts.note: noon is midday
lunch is at one o'clock, written AT I with the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: Signs suggest that midday is roughly the time when people break for lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts T and AT I (at one, in Roman numerals) inside NOON, giving NO-TATI-ON.
explanation.definitionFit: A notation is a system of written symbols, as in musical or mathematical signs.

clue.text: See 1
Contests securing figure London theatre parts

indicators.note: securing means holding fast, so these letters enclose the others

parts.note: comps is short for competitions
one is a figure, a number
NT is the National Theatre on London's South Bank

explanation.surface: Competitions win a figure some roles at a London theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'securing' is the containment signal. The National Theatre is the major state-funded theatre on London's South Bank.
explanation.definitionFit: Components are the individual pieces that together make up a whole.

clue.text: Lady setter in trim condition picked up

indicators.note: picked up as in heard on a radio, so the phrase is taken by sound

parts.note: the setter of a crossword refers to themself as I, and someone in trim condition is lean

explanation.surface: A woman who sets puzzles is overheard while in good physical shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' signals that I LEAN, spoken, gives the girl's name EILEEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Eileen is a woman's first name, and a lady stands for any woman's name in crosswords.

clue.text: Ragamuffin staggering out of bounds

indicators.note: bounds are the outer edges, so the word loses its first and last letters

parts.note: lurching is staggering unsteadily

explanation.surface: A scruffy child stumbles out of a restricted area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of bounds' strips the L and G from the ends of LURCHING.
explanation.definitionFit: An urchin is a poor, raggedly dressed child, the very picture of a ragamuffin.

clue.text: Troubled diet, or danger, is this?

definitions.text: Troubled diet, or danger, is this?

indicators.note: troubled means disturbed or upset, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A question asking whether a troubled diet, or the danger it brings, is this condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Troubled' rearranges DIET OR DANGER IS, all fourteen letters, into the answer; the whole clue also describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: An eating disorder is a medical condition marked by a disturbed, potentially dangerous relationship with food.

clue.text: Gentleness keeping idiot in line

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a ley, or ley line, is a supposed straight line linking ancient sites
nit, short for nitwit, is an idiot

explanation.surface: Kindness that keeps a fool in order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' is the containment signal. A ley line is a supposed alignment of ancient sites, a crossword favourite for LEY.
explanation.definitionFit: Lenity is mildness or mercifulness, especially in punishment, so a formal word for clemency.

clue.text: Suggested not breaking any laws on terror

indicators.note: on means placed after, so this piece follows the other in an across answer

parts.note: a little terror is a mischievous child, an imp
licit means lawful

explanation.surface: It was suggested that terror is not against any law.
explanation.definitionFit: Something implicit is implied rather than stated, so hinted at without being said.

clue.text: Travels round with some soldiers and privates

parts.note: OR, other ranks, are soldiers below officer level
bits is a slang term for private parts

explanation.surface: Someone goes on a tour with some soldiers and lowest-ranking enlisted men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'privates' looks like army rank, fitting the soldiers, but it is slang for genitals: BITS.
explanation.definitionFit: A planet orbits the Sun by circling it, so it travels in a loop around it.

clue.text: Card trick taking in broadcasters, say

indicators.note: taking in means containing, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a con is a trick or swindle
broadcasters are an example of the media

explanation.surface: A card trick fools the broadcasters, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Card' looks like a playing card beside 'trick', but it is the definition: a card is a funny person. 'taking in' is the containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A card is an amusing, eccentric person, much like a joker or comic.

clue.text: An indication of assent over car's current age

parts.note: a nod shows agreement
O is the cricket abbreviation for over
the Mini is a small British car

explanation.surface: A nod of agreement passed over the car's present age.
explanation.definitionFit: Anno Domini, AD, labels years of the present era, counted from the birth of Christ.

clue.text: Cricketer less streamlined after a couple of starters for lunch

indicators.note: after means this piece follows the others

parts.words: a couple of starters for lunch
parts.note: A, then a couple of L's: the starter, or first letter, of lunch taken twice
rounder means more curved, so less sleek in shape

explanation.surface: A cricketer has grown plumper after a few lunchtime starters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starters' suggests a first course, but it means the first letter of lunch; 'a couple of' gives A plus that letter twice.
explanation.definitionFit: An all-rounder is a cricket player skilled at both batting and bowling.

clue.text: Bagging 500 in opening spell of bowling is excessive

indicators.note: bagging means capturing, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: in cricket an over is a spell of six balls, and the opening one is over one
D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: Taking 500 wickets in the first over would be excessive for a bowler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bagging' is the containment signal. In cricket an over is a set of six deliveries by one bowler, so the first is over one.
explanation.definitionFit: Overdone means done too much, exaggerated or carried to excess.

clue.text: Highlight from fight, including its location

indicators.note: including means containing, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a bout is a boxing match
a boxing bout takes place in a ring

explanation.surface: A clip of the best moment from a fight, showing where it happened.
explanation.walkthrough: 'including' is the containment signal; 'its location' refers back to the fight, a boxing match held in a ring.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring out a feature is to emphasise or make it stand out.

clue.text: See 8
He made great scores in game with cracking drive

parts.note: monte is a card game, as in three-card monte

indicators.note: cracking means breaking apart, so the letters of drive are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sportsman posted big totals in a match thanks to a superb drive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scores' suggests sporting runs, but they are musical scores. 'cracking' turns DRIVE into VERDI, itself a composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Claudio Monteverdi was an Italian composer of early operas, so his written music was great.

clue.text: See 1
Burning tar by lounge

parts.note: a tar is a sailor, as is AB, an able seaman
to laze is to lounge about

explanation.surface: Hot tar is laid down beside a lounge.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ablaze is on fire, flaming fiercely.

clue.text: Channel's special feature

parts.note: a trait is a distinguishing feature

explanation.surface: A TV channel has a special feature programme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Channel' suggests television, but it is a sea passage.
explanation.definitionFit: A strait is a narrow sea passage joining two larger bodies of water.

clue.text: A saying about limiting consumption, fundamentally

indicators.note: limiting means bounding, so these letters enclose the other piece
about means turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a motto is a saying
consumption is an old name for tuberculosis, TB

explanation.surface: A slogan about cutting back on what we consume, at its core.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' reverses the saying, and 'limiting' has A and the reversal enclose the old name for tuberculosis.
explanation.definitionFit: At bottom means basically, in essence, beneath the surface.

clue.text: General staff ultimately administered business

indicators.note: ultimately means in the end, so the last letter is taken

parts.note: ran means managed or administered
CO is the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: In the end, the employees ran the company themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'General' looks like an adjective, but it is the military rank.
explanation.definitionFit: Francisco Franco was a Spanish general who ruled Spain as dictator.

clue.text: Drink — it's knocked back by family member breaking into song

indicators.note: knocked back means sent backwards, so the word is read in reverse
breaking into means entering, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: an aria is an operatic song
ma is mother

explanation.surface: A drink is downed by a relative who bursts into song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked back' looks like drinking, fitting the surface, but it is the reversal signal; 'breaking into' is the containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Tia Maria is a coffee liqueur, a branded alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Decisive strike with daring German spirit

parts.note: a KO, knockout, is a decisive blow
bold means daring

explanation.surface: A knockout blow delivered with courageous German fighting spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'German spirit' sounds like national courage, but it is a supernatural being.
explanation.definitionFit: A kobold is a goblin or sprite of German folklore, haunting houses and mines.

clue.text: Pick flavoursome apple that's warmer

parts.note: to elect is to choose
rich food is full of flavour
an eater is an eating apple, as opposed to a cooker

explanation.surface: Choose a tasty apple that is less chilly.
explanation.walkthrough: An eater is the British term for an apple eaten raw rather than cooked.
explanation.definitionFit: An electric heater is an appliance that warms a room.

clue.text: See 26
